name: Harley Quinn
description: Harley Quinn has finally broken things off once and for all with the Joker. Now, she's trying to make it on her own as the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City, with help from Poison Ivy and a ragtag crew of DC castoffs.

videos.title: Ask Harley Quinn
videos.overview: In-character Q&A with Harley Quinn, presented during the DC Fandome August 2020 event.

videos.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Harley Quinn is fed up being the Joker's sidekick and strikes out on her own – determined to become the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City.

videos.title: A High Bar
videos.overview: Determined to become one of the vaunted Legion of Doom, Harley attempts to make a big splash by crashing one of their criminal enterprises with the help of her BFF, Poison Ivy.

videos.title: So, You Need a Crew?
videos.overview: Realizing she needs a crew to pull off heists that will attract the Legion of Doom's attention, Harley attempts to recruit Dr. Psycho and Clayface.

videos.title: Finding Mr. Right
videos.overview: In search of a nemesis, Harley goes after Batman, but ends up with an adolescent Robin, making her the laughing stock of the criminal underworld.

videos.title: Being Harley Quinn
videos.overview: When Harley suffers a paralyzing identity crisis, her crew must enter Harley's mind to free her with the help of Dr. Psycho's telepathic powers.

videos.title: You're a Damn Good Cop, Jim Gordon
videos.overview: When Clayface loses his arm in a heist, it turns out to be not only evidence for Jim Gordon, but also a key witness against Harley and her crew.

videos.title: The Line
videos.overview: Harley recruits her friend and mentor Queen of Fables to help her steal a force field from STAR Labs, to steal a weather-changing machine, so she can impress the Legion of Doom. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy dates Kite Man.

videos.title: L.O.D.R.S.V.P
videos.overview: Harley gets an invite to the Legion of Doom's prospective members party, but Ivy learns that she's the one they're really interested in.

videos.title: A Seat at the Table
videos.overview: Now a member of the Legion of Doom and The Joker’s equal, Harley finds herself spending time with him. Will she slip into her old ways?

videos.title: Bensonhurst
videos.overview: After a falling out with her crew, Harley heads back home to Bensonhurst, where her doting mother waits for her... and her deadbeat dad, who’s more dangerous than anticipated.

videos.title: Harley Quinn Highway
videos.overview: Harley must rescue Ivy from the clutches of Scarecrow, who’s trying to harvest her pheromones to make a super toxin that turns plants into sentient monsters.

videos.title: Devil's Snare
videos.overview: Harley thinks the Legion of Doom is behind Ivy's capture and the tree monsters currently ravaging Gotham. But it's a trap!

videos.title: The Final Joke
videos.overview: In the season finale, Harley has her final showdown with the Joker, when [spoilers] [spoil] [spoilers]. Will they [spoiler]? Maybe. But you can bet they [spoiler]!

videos.title: New Gotham
videos.overview: After Gotham is declared no longer part of the United States, the newly formed Injustice League tries to seize control of the city away from Harley.

videos.title: Riddler U
videos.overview: Harley & Ivy go undercover as college students to take down Riddler, who's made himself dean of the local university with sinister plans for students.

videos.title: Catwoman
videos.overview: Harley & Ivy team up with Catwoman to steal a museum artifact that's been boobytrapped by Dr. Trap. Meanwhile, Dr. Psycho tries to prove himself as a leader.

videos.title: Thawing Hearts
videos.overview: Harley and crew try to infiltrate Mr. Freeze's lair only to become human lab rats for his experiments to find a cure for his cryogenically frozen wife, Nora.

videos.title: Batman's Back, Man
videos.overview: Bruce Wayne awakens from his coma to Gotham in chaos.

videos.title: All the Best Inmates Have Daddy Issues
videos.overview: When Harley and Ivy spot a seemingly sane Joker, they debate whether people can change at their core, revisiting a flashback about Harleen Quinzel's first day at Arkham Asylum.

videos.title: There's No Place to Go But Down
videos.overview: Acting as a judge, Two Face sentences Harley and Ivy to life in Bane's prison. Meanwhile, Jim Gordon and Batgirl vow to take back the GCPD from Two Face.

videos.title: Inner (Para) Demons
videos.overview: While Harley & Ivy deal with their post-kiss awkwardness, the President tells Gordon that he must get rid of Harley to put Gotham back on the map.

videos.title: Bachelorette
videos.overview: It's Bachelor/Bachelorette weekend for Ivy and Kite Man.

videos.title: Dye Hard
videos.overview: Alone on Christmas Eve, Harley reconnects with a now-sane Joker and heads to Wayne Tower, where their dinner is interrupted by an escaped Riddler and ParaDemons.

videos.title: A Fight Worth Fighting For
videos.overview: In order to defeat Psycho's army, Harley & Joker need to track down Fables' storybook with the Justice League inside.

videos.title: Lovers' Quarrel
videos.overview: Psycho unleashes a mind-controlled Ivy, Clayface, and King Shark on the Justice League who are trying to free Gotham.

videos.title: Something Borrowed, Something Green
videos.overview: Harley crashes Ivy's wedding to stop Gordon and his officers from interrupting the nuptials.

videos.title: Harlivy
videos.overview: After fleeing the wedding, Harley and Ivy go on an "Eat Bang Kill" tour that leads them to a secret project Ivy abandoned years ago.

videos.title: There's No Ivy in Team
videos.overview: After a heist gone wrong, Harley takes the crew to an escape room to foster camaraderie and sharpen Ivy’s leadership skills.

videos.title: The 83rd Annual Villy Awards
videos.overview: After receiving a “Best Couple” nomination at the 83rd Annual Villy Awards, Ivy finds herself seated next to her ex’s new girlfriend while Harley goes overboard to ensure their win.

videos.title: A Thief, A Mole, An Orgy
videos.overview: When Frank goes missing, Harley and Ivy follow clues that lead them to a highly unconventional party alongside Gotham’s elite, including Commissioner Gordon – who is hungry for campaign donations.

videos.title: It's a Swamp Thing
videos.overview: Harley, Ivy, and Nora travel to New Orleans in search of Swamp Thing, who just might be able to help them find Frank.

videos.title: Joker: The Killing Vote
videos.overview: When The Joker runs for mayor of Gotham, Two Face attempts to sabotage his campaign.

videos.title: Another Sharkley Adventure
videos.overview: Harley infiltrates a gala on a mission to confront Frank's captor... only to be entangled in another evil plot.

videos.title: Batman Begins Forever
videos.overview: After Harley receives access to Bruce Wayne's mind, she gets stuck in an endless loop of his most formative memory.

videos.title: Climax at Jazzapajizza
videos.overview: When an inadvertent plant zombie apocalypse breaks out in Gotham, Harley fights to save the city, while Ivy embraces her inner supervillain.

videos.title: The Horse and The Sparrow
videos.overview: After her terraforming plan goes awry, Ivy is enticed by an offer to take over the Legion of Doom, while Harley questions her path forward.

videos.title: A Very Problematic Valentine's Day Special
videos.overview: Harley goes overboard in her attempts to give Ivy the best Valentine’s Day ever. Bane’s efforts to impress an unexpected date go horribly awry. Clayface engages in some self-love.

videos.title: Gotham's Hottest Hotties
videos.overview: Harley and Ivy struggle to find their footing in their new respective roles in the Bat Family and the Legion of Doom.

videos.title: B.I.T.C.H.
videos.overview: After breaking the Bat Family's #1 rule, a demoted Harley shadows Alfred, while Ivy finds an unexpected mentor at a networking event.

videos.title: Icons Only
videos.overview: In Vegas for some much-needed QT, Harley struggles at the Strip's evilest hotel while a desperate lvy tries to secure tickets to Clayface's show.

videos.title: The First Person to Come Back from a Business Conference Without Chlamydia
videos.overview: Lex Luthor keeps Ivy on a short leash at a conference on the moon, while the Bat Family rents out Wayne Manor after Talia slashes company finances.

videos.title: Getting Ice Dick, Don't Wait Up
videos.overview: When Batgirl goes missing, Harley goes on an adventure with her roommate, while a spotlight-shy Ivy connects with a PR team after her Malcon success.

videos.title: Metamorphosis
videos.overview: Harley investigates the sudden death of a hero, while Ivy tries to take down the Jons and Joker announces a career change.

videos.title: The Most Culturally Impactful Film Franchise of All Time
videos.overview: Harley's desire to spend more time with Ivy sends them to a post-apocalyptic future. Batgirl seeks out a killer. Joker gets caught in a lie.

videos.title: Il Buffone
videos.overview: While Lex lays siege to the LOD after coming up short with his Ozone Machine, Bane travels to Italy to fix a pasta-maker... and win Nora's affection.

videos.title: Potato-Based Cloning Incident
videos.overview: In a bid to stop Lex, Ivy competes in a celebrity golf tournament. Meanwhile, Harley learns a dark truth about herself... from herself.

videos.title: Killer's Block
videos.overview: Ivy crashes a birthday party on the moon. Harley contemplates how to best avenge her friend.

videos.title: The Big Apricot
videos.overview: No longer Gotham's "...Most Exciting-est Couple Ever," Harley and Ivy decide to shake things up at Metropolis' event of the year.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: While Ivy's first day of work brings an unwelcome surprise, Harley juggles babysitting, landing a club membership, and her new friendship with Lena.

videos.title: Floronic Man
videos.overview: Despite closing the door on her academic trauma, Ivy's past still haunts her. Clayface confronts the Daily Planet's top brass after a bad review.

videos.title: Breaking Brainiac
videos.overview: Brainiac has one last task to finish before he can be promoted within the Coluian government -- but unforeseen variables change his life forever.

videos.title: Big Pasta Dinner
videos.overview: Old wounds and fears bubble to the surface when Harley and Ivy are invited to a meet and greet for their condo building.

videos.title: Bottle My Heart
videos.overview: After Lena divulges Brainiac's plans to the Daily Planet, Harley, Clayface, Bane and Frank try to take him down with an original musical.

videos.title: Frankette
videos.overview: The team gains a surprising new addition in the wake of a devastating loss. Meanwhile, as Ivy and Harley set out to bring the murderer to justice, Bane must protect Goldie and the other school kids from citywide destruction.

videos.title: Family Feud
videos.overview: With tensions between them at an all-time high, Harley heads to Bensonhurst for a family emergency, while Ivy vows to take down Lena once and for all.

videos.title: Bottle Episode (But Not a 'Bottle Episode')
videos.overview: As Harley and Ivy attempt to save Metropolis from complete destruction, Bruce, the Joker and Lois form an unexpected alliance.

videos.title: The Mess Is the Point
videos.overview: Harley, Ivy and Sharon team up with Brainiac to save the universe from Lex and Lena's total domination.
